prompt: Create an original 60 second contemporary organ music instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: pipe organ, low strings. Style: slow pedal tones and open suspended harmony. Tempo approximately 68 BPM; C major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A grand and majestic orchestral piece with a classical feel, featuring prominent strings, brass, and percussion, building to a triumphant climax.
description.zh: 一首宏大而庄严的管弦乐作品，具有古典风格，以突出的弦乐、铜管乐和打击乐为主，逐渐达到高潮。
